fields.Trigger: Customer presents gift card as payment

workflows.name: In-Store Gift Card Redemption at POS

Automation Opportunity: - Redemption and revenue-posting fully automated in the POS flow; balance auto-printed on receipt
Controls: - CTL-392 (ensure controlled execution — Gift Card Redemption & Balance Management (PA-54.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Balance-dispute risk**: the system shows a different balance than the customer expects (a prior partial redemption forgotten), causing a dispute; mitigated by the balance-printed-on-receipt history and the W2152 balance-inquiry channel

- **Revenue-recognition-timing risk**: the redemption posts to revenue in the wrong period (cross-period redemption), distorting the monthly close; mitigated by the real-time posting and the W2158 daily reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - POS / stored-value (links to VS-08 / W5B, W28, POS-013 real-time) — the redemption and the balance update
- Revenue recognition (links to VS-17 / W28, VS-157 / PFRS 15) — the liability→revenue posting at redemption
- Liability GL (links to VS-17 / W28) — the reduced liability balance

steps.activity: Cashier scans the gift card; system displays the balance; customer confirms the amount to redeem; system applies the redemption, posts the liability→revenue conversion (the redeemed amount leaves gift-card liability and posts to revenue per PFRS 15), and prints the updated balance on the receipt

fields.Trigger: Customer applies gift card at ecommerce checkout

Automation Opportunity: - Redemption fully automated; balance real-time across channels
Controls: - CTL-392 (ensure controlled execution — Gift Card Redemption & Balance Management (PA-54.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraud-risk**: a fraudster uses a gift-card number generated by a brute-force script (especially on low-PIN cards); mitigated by the redemption-attempt rate-limit and the fraud-monitoring (W2160)

- **Cross-channel-latency risk**: a redemption online doesn't reflect in-store immediately (or vice versa), allowing double-spend; mitigated by the real-time omnichannel stored-value (single authoritative balance)
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce / stored-value (links to VS-10 / W11, W180; VS-08 / W28) — the online redemption
- Omnichannel stored-value (links to VS-60 / W536 unified order management) — the real-time cross-channel balance
- Revenue recognition (links to VS-17 / W28, VS-157) — the liability→revenue posting
Time Estimate: System automated; Ecommerce Ops ~4 hours/week = **~200 hours/year**.

steps.activity: Customer enters the gift card number/PIN at checkout; system validates the balance, applies the redemption, converts liability→revenue, and completes the order; balance updated in real-time across all channels (omnichannel stored-value)

fields.Trigger: Customer requests balance via any channel

Automation Opportunity: - Inquiry fully self-service across channels; rate-limited
Controls: - CTL-392 (rate-limit / enumeration guard); CTL-44 (balance integrity); operational: Customer Service Manager monitoring
Pain Points / Risks: - **Balance-enumeration risk**: a brute-force script uses the inquiry channel to enumerate valid card-numbers (then redeem); mitigated by the inquiry rate-limit and the PIN requirement
- **Channel-fragmentation risk**: the SMS channel shows a different balance than the app (sync lag); mitigated by the single authoritative stored-value balance
System Touchpoints: - Stored-value inquiry (links to VS-08 / W28, VS-75 app) — the balance API
- Self-service channels (links to VS-10 web, VS-75 app) — the customer-facing inquiry
- RA 10173 privacy (links to VS-91 / W53) — the card-number/PIN as access credentials (not PII in the traditional sense, but access-controlled)
Time Estimate: ~1.5 min/inquiry (CSR-handled subset; most are self-service) × ~4,000/month = **~100 hours/month CSR**, declining as self-service grows.

steps.activity: Customer requests balance via SMS (text the card number), app/web (enter number+PIN), or in-store (CSR scans); system returns the current balance and recent transactions

fields.Trigger: Customer reports lost or stolen physical card

Automation Opportunity: - Freeze/transfer/deactivate fully system-controlled on CSR authorization; loyalty-link auto-suggested at sale
Controls: - CTL-392 (ensure controlled execution — Gift Card Redemption & Balance Management (PA-54.2).)
- operational: Customer Service Manager sign-off on replacements >PHP 5K
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraudulent-claim risk**: a customer falsely claims a card is lost to double-spend (keep the original, get a replacement); mitigated by the proof-of-purchase requirement and the freeze-on-original (if the original is redeemed after the claim, it's flagged)

- **Unregistered-card-loss risk**: an unregistered card (gift recipient, cash purchase) can't be ownership-verified, so the balance is unrecoverable; mitigated by the loyalty-link encouragement at sale (register the card for lost-card protection)
System Touchpoints: - Stored-value / card status (links to VS-08 / W28) — the freeze, transfer, and deactivation
- Loyalty / customer link (links to VS-13 / W17) — the registered-card ownership verification
- CRM (links to VS-13 / W41) — the lost-card case record

steps.activity: CSR verifies the customer's identity and card ownership (proof of purchase, card number from the receipt); if the card is registered (loyalty-linked), the verification is straightforward; system freezes the card balance to prevent fraudulent redemption
CSR issues a replacement card (new number) with the frozen balance transferred; the old card number is permanently deactivated; customer notified

fields.Trigger: Customer uses multiple gift cards for one transaction

workflows.name: Gift Card Partial Redemption & Multi-Card Payment

Automation Opportunity: - Multi-card-scan with auto-sequence application; drain-to-zero auto-suggested
Controls: - CTL-392 (ensure controlled execution — Gift Card Redemption & Balance Management (PA-54.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Transaction-stall risk**: a multi-card transaction with many small-balance cards stalls the checkout queue; mitigated by the multi-card-scan limit (e.g., max 5 cards per transaction) and the drain-to-zero auto-option
- **Balance-rounding-error risk**: partial redemption leaves a sub-cent balance that becomes unredeemable; mitigated by the drain-to-zero on balances <PHP 1
System Touchpoints: - POS / stored-value (links to VS-08 / W5B, W28) — the multi-card partial-redemption logic
- Revenue recognition (links to VS-17 / W28, VS-157) — the per-card liability→revenue posting
- Omnichannel balance (links to VS-60 / W536) — the real-time balance update per card

steps.activity: Cashier scans multiple gift cards; system applies each in sequence (partial redemption per card, draining each toward the transaction total); posts each liability→revenue conversion; prints the updated balance on each card's receipt

fields.Trigger: Customer adds value to existing gift card

Automation Opportunity: - Reload and liability-posting fully automated; AMLA threshold auto-prompted
Controls: - CTL-392 (ensure controlled execution — Gift Card Redemption & Balance Management (PA-54.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reload-to-stolen-card risk**: a fraudster reloads a stolen/lost card before the W2153 freeze lands, then redeems; mitigated by the real-time freeze propagation and the reload-on-flagged-card block
- **Revenue-misrecognition risk**: the reload posted as revenue (not liability) — same risk as W2143; mitigated by the system-controlled posting
System Touchpoints: - POS / stored-value (links to VS-08 / W28) — the reload and liability posting
- AMLA KYC (links to VS-86 / W2143) — the high-value-cash-reload trigger
- Omnichannel balance (links to VS-60 / W536) — the real-time balance update

steps.activity: Customer presents an existing card (physical or digital) and pays the reload amount; system adds the amount to the stored-value liability and updates the balance; same AMLA KYC threshold applies to cash reloads ≥PHP 50K

fields.Trigger: Gift card reaches 5-year expiry or monthly analysis

Automation Opportunity: - Expiry batch auto-run daily; breakage-estimate-vs-actual auto-flagged
Controls: - CTL-392 (PFRS 15 breakage accounting — links to VS-157); CTL-44 (liability integrity); operational: Finance Manager monthly sign-off; CFO quarterly review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Breakage-estimate-error risk**: the PFRS 15 expected-breakage estimate diverges from actual, creating a liability over/understatement; mitigated by the monthly actual-vs-estimate analysis and the estimate recalibration

- **Consumer-complaint risk**: a customer redeems an "expired" card (the 5-year window is a minimum, not a hard expiry under consumer-protection practice); mitigated by the goodwill-reinstatement policy (honor the expired card on customer request, reversing the breakage)
System Touchpoints: - Stored-value / breakage (links to VS-08 / W28, VS-17 / W9A month-end) — the expiry batch and the breakage posting
- PFRS 15 revenue recognition (links to VS-157 / W911, VS-17 / W28) — the breakage-estimate methodology
- Liability reconciliation (links to VS-54 / W2158 daily reconciliation) — the liability-vs-outstanding-card reconciliation
Time Estimate: ~6 hours/month Finance Manager + daily batch automated = **~70–80 hours/year**.

steps.activity: System flags cards reaching the 5-year-expiry window (per RA 7394 / consumer-protection practice); daily batch processes the expired balance to breakage revenue per PFRS 15 (Dr. Gift Card Liability / Cr. Breakage Revenue)

Finance Manager performs monthly breakage analysis: actual breakage rate vs. the PFRS 15 expected-breakage estimate; adjusts the estimate if the actual diverges; reconciles the liability balance to the outstanding-card registry

fields.Trigger: Customer requests cancellation within cooling-off or error correction

Controls: - CTL-392 (ensure controlled execution — Gift Card Redemption & Balance Management (PA-54.2).)
- operational: Customer Service Manager sign-off on cancellations >PHP 5K
Pain Points / Risks: - **Refund-fraud risk**: a fraudster buys a card with a stolen payment method, then requests a refund to a different (their own) payment method; mitigated by the refund-to-original-payment-method-only policy
- **Cancellation-abuse risk**: repeated purchase-cancel cycles (testing stolen cards); mitigated by the cancellation-frequency monitoring per customer
System Touchpoints: - Stored-value / cancellation (links to VS-08 / W28, VS-16 / W101 refund) — the liability reversal and refund
- Payment reversal (links to VS-08 / W5B, VS-16 / W101) — the refund to the original payment method
- Fraud-monitoring (links to VS-54 / W2160) — the cancellation-frequency as a fraud signal

steps.activity: CS Supervisor reviews the cancellation request: cooling-off period (within 24–48 hours of purchase, unredeemed), error correction (wrong denomination loaded), or fraud-claim reversal; verifies the card is unredeemed; processes the refund (reverse the liability, refund the original payment method)

fields.Frequency: ~2–5 unplanned events/yr chain-wide (planned maintenance windows are excluded — those ride the standard release calendar with pre-announced downtime)
fields.Owner: Category Manager (Gift Cards) / CRM-Loyalty Manager (points engine)
fields.Participants: Store Managers & Front-End, Customer Service (VS-13 desk), IT incident management (root cause), Finance (liability postings per W28-class), Loss Prevention (manual-mode abuse watch), Marketing (customer messaging), Ecommerce (online redemption holds)
fields.Trigger: The gift-card/stored-value platform or the loyalty points engine is unavailable at POS or online for more than 30 minutes during trading — balance verification, redemption, earn, or reload failure affecting customer tenders and benefits
fields.Volume: 1 event × the redemption population (gift-card tender share of 2.8M monthly POS transactions plus the loyalty-attached majority of baskets) × the liability surface: outstanding gift-card balances plus unredeemed points liability across the program

workflows.name: Stored-Value & Loyalty Platform Outage, Downtime-Acceptance & Manual-Redemption Protocol

Automation Opportunity: - Platform heartbeat auto-triggers the event case and displays the exposure matrix decision options with the current outstanding-liability figure (replaces manual Steps 1–2 assembly)
- Batch-entry reconciliation auto-matches paper vouchers against electronic postings and queues duplicates/variances (replaces manual Step 5 sweeps)
Background: W2150–W2157 own the steady-state gift-card lifecycle and W3699 owns points/gift-card *integrity* monitoring — but nobody owns the outage event: the downtime-acceptance decision (honor last-known balances to a cap vs suspend redemption), the manual-redemption mode with its fraud exposure, the earn-posting catch-up, and the liability true-up after recovery. The exposure is asymmetric: refusing redemption alienates gift-card and loyalty customers at the till (the most engaged segment), while uncapped manual acceptance invites abuse against balances that cannot be verified. The protocol pre-authorizes the exposure matrix so a store never makes that trade-off live under queue pressure. Custody per E-23: technical restoration runs the IT incident canon; acceptance-exposure decisions and the liability ledger always live here; POS mechanics execute per the VS-08 flags.
Controls: - CTL-392 (ensure controlled execution — Gift Card Redemption & Balance Management (PA-54.2).)
- operational: manual redemption never exceeds the pre-approved per-card cap without VP Marketing + CFO sign-off; every manual voucher batch-enters before the liability true-up closes
- operational: every outage event closes with the earn-posting reconciliation evidenced (no silent points loss)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Refusal-outrage risk**: loyal gift-card/points customers refused at the till queue-pressured; mitigated by the pre-approved honor-to-cap matrix decided centrally in Step 2, not at the till
- **Liability-error risk**: manual vouchers mis-entered or double-posted on recovery; mitigated by the Step-5 batch-entry reconciliation and duplicate sweep
- **Abuse-window risk**: fabricated/no-balance claims against the cap; mitigated by ID capture, physical-evidence rule, LP watch and the cap itself as the exposure bound
- **Points-trust risk**: earned points silently lost in the outage; mitigated by the retroactive earn-posting reconciliation and the 14-day no-questions claim window
- **Recurrence risk**: same platform fails the same way next peak; mitigated by the Step-7 RTO/RPO policy and maintenance-window discipline
Staffing Implication: - Absorbed by the existing gift-card program, CRM-Loyalty, Finance and store front-end teams; the protocol converts improvisation into a bounded matrix. No incremental headcount.
System Touchpoints: - Gift-card ledger & manual-redemption voucher register (batch-entry queue on recovery)
- Loyalty engine earn/redeem queues with outage-window catch-up posting (links to the loyalty program operations in VS-13)
- POS manual-mode flags, per-card caps and receipt annotation templates
- Stored-value & points liability GL accounts (links to W28-class liability accounting; breakage per W2156)
- Fraud-watch dashboard for manual-mode patterns (links to W3699 integrity monitoring)
- Customer Service goodwill-case records (links to VS-13 desk)
Time Estimate: Per event: Steps 1–4 ≈ 3–8 staff-hours (central decision + per-store execution in parallel); Steps 5–7 ≈ 16–40 staff-hours (batch entry, reconciliation, remediation window). At ~2–5 events/yr ≈ 38–240 staff-hours/yr, absorbed by Finance, CRM-Loyalty and Front-End — no incremental headcount.

steps.activity: **Outage scope & mode**: confirm which functions failed (balance-verify only / redeem / earn / reload) and which surfaces (POS, online, both); open the event log; classify expected duration with IT (transient glitch vs platform incident)

**Downtime-acceptance decision** per the pre-approved exposure matrix: (a) balance-verify only → honor displayed/last-known balance up to the per-card cap (default PHP 5,000) with ID capture; (b) redemption-engine down → suspend gift-card and points redemption, accept earn retroactively (points post on recovery); (c) full-platform down → manual-redemption mode (Step 3) below the cap only for customers with physical card/receipt evidence

**Manual-redemption execution**: POS manual-voucher mode — paper voucher + card number + valid ID recorded, receipt annotated "manual redemption — outage", cap enforced at the till; online orders with gift-card tender held (not cancelled) pending recovery

**Fraud watch during manual mode**: LP monitors serial manual redemptions, cap-adjacent claims and no-balance-card patterns; suspected-abuse cases refused politely with escalation script; all manual vouchers retained for batch entry

**Recovery & catch-up posting**: platform restore verified in canary store first; paper vouchers batch-entered; earn-posting reconciliation for the outage window (every basket that earned but could not post); duplicate-redemption sweep (cards manually redeemed that also posted electronically)

**Customer remediation**: missed-points claims accepted with POS receipt evidence via Customer Service (no-questions window of 14 days); goodwill points per policy where a refusal occurred; online held orders released or refunded per customer choice

**Liability true-up & post-mortem**: points/gift-card liability accounts trued-up for the manual-mode exposure and catch-up postings; variance beyond tolerance investigated; post-mortem with IT covers RTO/RPO targets for the platform, the maintenance-window policy, and any matrix cap adjustments
